_comment: Hook lines for the Comedy Brew Eventfrog pages, written by script/eventfrog-content.ts. One hook per date, picked by the show date so a page keeps its line. Each hook ends up as the title suffix after 'Comedy Brew, English Stand-Up: ' and as the first bold sentence of the description. Keep them evergreen (no tonight, no weather, no weekday but Thursday), at most 29 characters (Eventfrog caps a title at 60 and the prefix takes 31), no full stop, and no city: Eventfrog appends 'in Zürich' to the title itself. The pool is walked one line per week from the first night in 2022, so consecutive Thursdays never repeat; adding or reordering lines shifts future dates once. Edit freely; the next 09:20 run rewrites the pages that changed.
hooks: New in town? This is Thursday
Lost in town? Find your funny
The group chat needed a plan
